title: Expected path indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let a path assign either no value or a value in $\bbr/2\bbr$ to each coordinate. Under the uniform probability measure on the binary cube, the expected value of the indicator of the path’s cylinder is $2^{-\ell}$, where $\ell$ is the number of coordinates assigned by the path.
hypotheses_covered: A path on the binary cube of dimension $n$
